# lambda-trigger-sns

Creates an SNS topic subscription that invokes a Lambda function when messages are published to the topic. Supports optional message filtering.

## Usage

```hcl
module "sns_trigger" {
  source = "../../modules/lambda-trigger-sns"

  function_name = module.my_function.function_name
  function_arn  = module.my_function.function_arn
  topic_arn     = aws_sns_topic.orders.arn

  filter_policy = jsonencode({
    event_type = ["order_placed", "order_shipped"]
  })
}
```

## IAM Model

This is a **push-based** trigger. The module creates an `aws_lambda_permission` resource-based policy allowing SNS to invoke the function. No IAM role attachment is needed.

## Inputs

### Required

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `function_name` | `string` | Name of the Lambda function. Used for resource naming and the Lambda permission. |
| `function_arn` | `string` | ARN of the Lambda function. Used as the SNS subscription endpoint. |
| `topic_arn` | `string` | ARN of the SNS topic to subscribe to. |

### Optional

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `filter_policy` | `string` | `null` | JSON-encoded SNS subscription filter policy. When `null` (default), the function receives all messages. When set, only messages matching the policy are delivered. Use `jsonencode()` to build the policy. See [AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-subscription-filter-policies.html) for filter syntax. |
| `filter_policy_scope` | `string` | `"MessageAttributes"` | Scope of the filter policy — determines which part of the message the filter is evaluated against. Possible values: `"MessageAttributes"` (default, filters on message attributes), `"MessageBody"` (filters on the message body JSON). |
| `tags` | `map(string)` | `{}` | Map of tags (accepted for interface consistency). |

## Outputs

| Name | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `subscription_arn` | ARN of the SNS topic subscription. |
